title: Tangent-cone cancellation and Maz'ya's $Φ$-inequalities on finitely cornered planar domains
summary: Let $0<α<2$ and $p=2/(2-α)$. We study critical nonlinear convolution inequalities for kernels $K:\mathbb{R}^2\setminus\{0\}\to\mathbb{R}^m$ and functions $Φ:\mathbb{R}^m\to\mathbb{R}$ positively homogeneous of degrees $α-2$ and $p$. We assume angular Lipschitz regularity for $Φ$ and angular $C^{0,γ}$ regularity for $K$, where $0<γ\le1$ and $γ=1$ if $p<2$. On bounded finitely cornered planar domains with a common Dini tangent modulus on the boundary branches, we characterize $|\int_ΩΦ(K*f) dx|\le C\|f\|_{L^1}^p$ for real densities $f\in L^1(\mathbb{R}^2)\cap L^s_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{R}^2)$,…
